status: PREPARED, not started (needs F11: invitations, consent, publication approval)

conditions.H1: single human, 40 min, task card + shard material on paper
conditions.H3: three humans from different disciplines, 40 min, moderated, same material
conditions.A1: single AI agent, same material, same token budget per person-equivalent
conditions.A3: three AI agents, one shard each, 2 exchange rounds (CE-02 arm C protocol)
conditions.M: mixed group: two humans + two agents (shards split), moderated, agents answer only when asked

tasks: CE-02 T3/T4 (generative) and X1/X2 (transfer) plus one open research question chosen by the moderator in advance; all registered before the session

controls.material: identical shard set for all conditions
controls.time: 40 min per task block for humans; agents get the token-equivalent budget recorded per session

measures.novelty: blinded judges 0-3: not contained in any single participant's pre-session note (pre-notes collected before the group phase)
measures.correctness: objective keys where available (frozen scorer v2.1 + provenance verifier); else judge 0-2
measures.insight_gain: emergenceGain(): verified items in the group output absent from all individual pre-notes
measures.practical_use: judge 0-2 + 4-week follow-up: was anything actually used (self-report, artefact if possible)
measures.self_determination: post-session scale on pressure/autonomy, count of agent interventions not asked for (must be 0 in M), right to withdraw honoured (1.0)

evaluation.scorer_validation_vs_experiment: the external scorer-holdout producers are listed as role scorer_validator and may not be judges or participants (roles.mjs)
evaluation.judges: >= 2 humans not participating + >= 1 non-Claude model judge; blinded condition codes; disagreements > 1 point recorded
evaluation.decision_rule: M > max(H3, A3) on insight_gain with correctness not lower and self_determination not worse, in >= 2 of 3 sessions
